name: visualize-skills
description: Two skills, one house style: visualize-the-fix diagrams a just-finished coding task (bug fix, refactor, new feature) instead of a wall of text, and visualize-the-plan diagrams a proposed plan before you build it. Built for vibe coders who lose track of what an AI agent changed or is about to change. Renders self-contained dark-mode-default HTML/SVG diagrams with a clickable glossary for jargon.

interface.shortDescription: Explain a finished change or visualize a proposed plan as a small diagram, not a wall of text.
interface.longDescription: Two skills sharing one house style. visualize-the-fix diagrams a just-finished coding task (bug fix, refactor, new feature) instead of a wall of text — classifying the diff into a causal chain, before/after refactor, sequence flow, or vertical deep-dive (cause → fix → why it works). visualize-the-plan does the same for a proposed plan before you build it — linear steps, a phased plan, a Now/Planned scope map, a decision fork, or a rationale deep-dive. Both render a self-contained, dark-mode-default HTML/SVG diagram with a clickable glossary for any jargon in the labels.
defaultPrompt: Visualize the fix you just made.
Visualize the plan before you start.
